questions.q: If A × B means that A is the father of B, A + B means that A is the mother of B, A ÷ B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that A is the paternal uncle of C?
questions.solution:

A × B
A is the father of B

A + B
A is the mother of B

A ÷ B
A is the brother of B

Option 1) A ÷ C + B means,

A is the brother of C, C is the mother of B.

Here A is the brother of C so A cannot be the paternal uncle of C.

Option 2) A ÷ B + C means,

A is the brother of B, B is the mother of C.

Here A is maternal uncle of C so A cannot be the paternal uncle of C.

Option 3) A + B ÷ C means,

A is the mother of B, B is the brother of C.

Here A is the mother of C so A cannot be the paternal uncle of C.

Option 4) A ÷ B × C means,

A is the brother of B, B is the father of C.

Here A is the paternal uncle of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

Key Points

• The cell physically expands, duplicates organelles, and creates the molecular building blocks it will require in subsequent stages during G1phase, also known as the first gap phase.

• The cell creates a full copy of the DNA in its nucleus during the S phase. Moreover, it makes duplicates of the centrosome, a structure that organises microtubules. During M phase, the centrosomes aid in the separation of DNA.

• The second gap phase, also known as the G2 phase, is a time of increased cell growth, protein and organelle production, and content reorganisation in preparation for mitosis.

• The cell's nuclear DNA condenses into its visible chromosomes during mitosis and is separated by the mitotic spindle, a specialised microtubule-based structure.

Additional Information

• Stages of the cell cycle

• ​A cell must grow, replicate its genetic material (DNA), and physically split into two daughter cells before it may divide.

• The cell cycle is a structured, predictable series of actions that cells take to complete these goals.

• Because the two daughter cells can restart the entire process from the beginning after each cycle, the cell cycle is a cycle rather than a linear pathway.

questions.q: If Q = net charge, t = time, then which of the following equations is correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is I =Q over t

Key Points

• Current, charge and time

• How much electric charge is transferred each second defines electrical current, giving the following relationship:

Current= charge/ time

Rearranging this we get,

charge= current * time

• The symbol for charge is Q, it is measured in coulombs (C).

• The symbol for current is I, it is measured in amperes (A).

• The symbol for time is t, it is measured in seconds (t).

• This gives the relation:

Q= I* t

Additional Information

• Current

• A stream of charged particles, like electrons or ions, moving through an electrical conductor or space is called an electric current.

• The net rate of electric charge flow through a surface or into a control volume is how it is measured.

• Depending on the conductor, the moving particles are referred to as charge carriers, which can be any one of a number of different types of particles.

• Charge

• A charge in physics can be any of a number of different quantities, such as the color charge in quantum chromodynamics or the electric charge in electromagnetism.

• The time-invariant generators of a symmetry group, and more specifically, the generators that commute with the Hamiltonian, are represented by charges.

• The charge invariance corresponds to the vanishing commutator [Q,H]=0, where H is the Hamiltonian because charges are frequently denoted by the letter Q.

• As a result, charges and conserved quantum numbers are linked; these are the eigenvalues q of the generator Q.

• Time

• From the past through the present and into the future, time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that appears to be irreversible.

• It is a component quantity of various measurements used to order events, compare their durations or intervals, and quantify rates of change of quantities in material reality or conscious experience.

• Along with the three spatial dimensions, time is frequently referred to as a fourth dimension.

• Whether a dancer is Hindu or not, their expressions are generally calm and convey Bhakti Rasa, or the emotion of devotion.

questions.q: From the point of view of commerce, the busiest ocean of the world is .
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Atlantic Ocean

Key Points

• Atlantic Ocean

• ​At a size of roughly 106,460,000 km2, the Atlantic Ocean is the second-largest of the world's five oceans (41,100,000 sq mi).

• It covers around 29% of the sea surface area and about 20% of the planet's surface.

• The "Old World" of Africa, Europe, and Asia is known to be distinguished from the "New World" of the Americas in the perspective of Europe.

• The Atlantic Ocean has been crucial to the growth of human society, globalisation, and the history of numerous states since it divides Africa, Europe, and Asia from the Americas.

Additional Information

• The Atlantic Ocean served as the epicentre of the Columbian Exchange and the namesake slave trade from the 16th through the 19th centuries, and it also periodically served as the scene of naval conflicts.

• While there haven't been any major military conflicts in the Atlantic in the current 21st century, the ocean still plays an important role in international trade.

• Both these naval battles and growing trade from regional American powers like the United States and Brazil increased in intensity during the 20th century.

• The Atlantic Ocean is located in an elongated, S-shaped basin that runs between North and South America to the west and Europe and Africa to the east.

questions.q: On which river, the first night navigation mobile application in rivers in India was launched for ferries?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Brahmaputra.

Key Points

• Brahmaputra

• ​The Brahmaputra is a trans-boundary river that passes through Tibet, Bangladesh, and Northeastern India.

• Other names for it include Luit in Assamese, the Yarlung Tsangpo in Tibetan, the Siang/Dihang River in Arunachali, and the Jamuna River in Bangla.

• It is the 15th longest river in the world and the 9th largest by discharge.

• The Yarlung Tsangpo River has its source in the Manasarovar Lake region, close to Mount Kailash, in Burang County, Tibet, on the northern face of the Himalayas.

Additional Information

• The river travels through southern Tibet before plunging into the Mountains in the Yarlung Tsangpo Great Canyon and entering Arunachal Pradesh.

• It enters India close to the Arunachal Pradesh settlement of Gelling and travels through Bangladesh as the Jamuna before flowing southwest through the Assam Valley (not to be confused with the Yamuna of India).

• It combines with the Ganges, also known as the Padma in Bangladesh, in the enormous Ganges Delta, where it then becomes the Meghna and eventually empties into the Bay of Bengal.

questions.q: Two trains are moving in the opposite direction at the speed of 48 km/hr and 60 km/hr respectively. The time taken by the slower train to cross a man sitting in the faster train is 12 seconds. What is the length of the slower train?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Relative speed in opposite directions = 48 + 60 = 108 km/hr.

Convert relative speed to m/s = 108 × (5/18) = 30 m/s.

Length of the slower train = Relative Speed × Time taken.

Length = 30 × 12 = 360 metres.

∴ The correct answer is 360 metres.

Given:

Speed of faster train (S₂) = 60 km/hr

Formula Used:

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = S₁ + S₂

Distance = Speed × Time

Conversion: 1 km/hr = 5/18 m/s

Calculations:

⇒ Relative Speed = 48 + 60 = 108 km/hr

⇒ Relative Speed in m/s = 108 × (5/18) = 30 m/s

⇒ The man sitting in the faster train represents a point object moving at 60 km/hr in the opposite direction.

⇒ The distance covered to cross the man is exactly equal to the length of the slower train.

⇒ Length of slower train = 30 m/s × 12 s

⇒ Length of slower train = 360 metres

∴ The correct answer is 360 metres.

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|. When they move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Crossing a Point Object

When a train crosses a pole, tree, or a standing/moving man, the total distance covered is equal to the length of the crossing train itself.

questions.q: A and B invested their money in a business in the ratio of 9 ∶ 5. If 10% of the total profit goes for charity and A’s share is Rs. 29,840, what is the total profit (in Rs., to the nearest integer)?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Total distributed profit = Total profit × 90%.

A's share = Total profit × (90 / 100) × [9 / (9 + 5)].

29840 = Total profit × (9 / 10) × (9 / 14).

Total profit = 29840 × (140 / 81) = 4177600 / 81 = 51575.30...

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 51,575.

Alternate Method

Given:

Investment ratio of A and B = 9 : 5

Percentage of profit going to charity = 10%

A's profit share = Rs. 29,840

Formula Used:

Profit ratio = Investment ratio (when the time period is identical)



Calculations:

⇒ Let the total profit be P.

⇒ Profit distributed between A and B = P − 10% of P = 90% of P = 0.9P.

⇒ Investment ratio of A and B = 9 : 5

⇒ Total ratio parts = 9 + 5 = 14 parts.

⇒ A's profit share = (9 / 14) of the remaining profit

⇒ 29840 = (9 / 14) × 0.9P

⇒ 29840 = (8.1 / 14) × P

⇒ P = (29840 × 14) / 8.1

⇒ P = 417760 / 8.1 = 4177600 / 81

⇒ P = 51575.308...

⇒ Rounding to the nearest integer, Total Profit ≈ Rs. 51,575

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 51,575.

Additional Information

Sleeping Partner

A partner who only invests money but does not take part in the management of the business is known as a sleeping partner. Active partners receive a fixed salary or a certain percentage of the profit for managing the business before the remaining profit is distributed among all partners.

Compound Partnership

When investments are made for different time periods, it is called a compound partnership. The profit share ratio is the product of capital invested and the time period of investment (P₁ : P₂ = C₁×T₁ : C₂×T₂).

Joining Mid-way

If a partner joins x months after the start of a financial year, their investment time period for that year is (12 − x) months, which must be multiplied by their capital to determine their final profit share ratio compared to the primary investors.
